messages:
Zoe: quick idea  let's coordinate a co-announce playbook for the LangChain + LlamaIndex adapter in our gateway. target: joint blog + marketplace listing + 60s demo clip. who wants in?
Matt: i'll take marketplace listing requirements and the SKU mapping. need images, short blurb, and pricing mode (per-1k tokens or monthly seat).
Priya: eng note  adapter should expose a small manifest and a function-calling shim for LangChain agents. i'll add a tiny sample.
Hugo: SI perspective: demo must show SSO, brief data isolation diagram, and rollback plan. keep demo under 5 minutes.
Zoe: good. timeline suggestion: week A - adapter + docs; week B - marketplace + legal + marketing assets; week C - dry run + announce window.
LegalBot: Action: LEGAL-77 created for logo use & co-marketing agreement. expect 4-6 business days for review.
MarketingOps: we need a 1-paragraph customer-facing blurb and 3 screenshots (1024x512). also want a 30-60s GIF of the demo hero flow.
Matt: adding metadata checklist: title, short blurb, long description, container digest, pricing unit, support contact, legal contact, screenshots, demo clip link. i'll drop template in the drive.
Priya: sample adapter README snippet for integrators: ```yaml
name: redwood-langchain-llamaindex-adapter
version: 0.1.0
supports:
  streaming: true
  function_calling: true
  kv_cache: true
resources:
  gpu: g5.12xlarge
  min_memory_gb: 48
```
Hugo: SI playbook outline: 1) Provision from marketplace, 2) Configure SSO & SCIM, 3) VPC peering + secrets, 4) Run LangChain agent smoke, 5) Failover test to hosted model, 6) Collect telemetry. i'll draft slides.
Zoe: risks: marketplace review delay, legal signoff, partner embargo window. add them to the sprint ticket.
SI_Paul: can we get an anonymized dataset? Brightline SI can provide support-ticket dumps sanitized. Paul will coordinate.
MarketingOps: can we align announce with the HW partner's webinar on the 3rd week? if so, need content locked 5 business days prior.
LegalBot: flagged: partner requires written approval for joint press release language. i'll coordinate a 1-pager.
Matt: i'll schedule a 30-min kickoff and add checklist items to MARKETPLACE-501. calendar invite sent.
Zoe: owners: Matt (marketplace), Priya (adapter + samples), Hugo (SI playbook), MarketingOps (assets + announce), LegalBot (agreements), SI_Paul (dataset). daily 10-min sync at 9:45 PT. :thumbsup:
Priya: small dev tip: include a local runner script so integrators can validate function-calls without cloud creds: ```bash
DEBUG=1 python examples/run_agent.py --adapter-url http://localhost:8080/generate
```
Hugo: noted. i'll make the demo script and a fallback checklist in case of infra hiccups.
Zoe: perfect. let's keep threads short and capture blockers in the ticket. thanks all.
